title: add RAG agent templates, tool-calling quickstart, and docs site updates
author: Priya Kapoor
description: Motivation: provide a small, opinionated set of RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts to lower the onboarding time for developers evaluating Redwood agents. This PR adds templated example agents (retriever + tool-calling patterns), a step-by-step quickstart for building a RAG agent with tool integrations, and minor docs site updates to surface the examples in the quickstarts navigation. The description below summarizes changes, review notes, CI, and merge outcome. Change summary: (1) examples/rag/templates: three opinionated templates (faq-bot, contextful-assistant, multi-tool-agent) with README and minimal test harness; (2) examples/agents/tool-calling: two small tool-calling examples (calendar-integration and lookup-tool) showing structured function calling and result handling; (3) docs/quickstarts/rag-agent.md: quickstart doc with prerequisites, sample config, and troubleshooting note about KV cache and batching; (4) site/navigation and docs index updated to include the new quickstart and example gallery; (5) small lint/format fixes across examples. Checklist: - [x] Add templates + examples - [x] Quickstart and snippets added to docs - [x] CI and example builds green after fix - [x] Docs nav updated - [x] Tested run locally with dev server Notes: avoided large dataset checks-in, examples rely on small fixture data and point to the model catalog for recommended model IDs. Related: ENG-2432, DES-118.
